variety_description: A high-yielding, late, short height, medium slender grain variety grown extensively in Eastern, Central, and Southern India. Developed by NRRI and released in 1999. It tolerates water stagnation upto 30 cm. Highly adapted to rainfed shallow lowlands. Erect and compact plant type with good grain quality and high glycemic index.
